translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Intraday rules (ORB, CPR, Camarilla, midday lull) are written for 5m/15m lanes; daily-bar variants are marked as approximations.

strategies.name: NR4 in Uptrend
strategies.entry: close > sma(close, 50) and (high - low)[1] == lowest(high - low, 4) and high > high[1]
strategies.notes: 2026-11-15 literal correction (gplm verify): previous interpretation used lowest(high - low, 4)[1] (window t-4..t-1); the original MIN(Range, 4) includes bar t | PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 470 mean net -0.253%; intraday trades 3657 mean net -0.143%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: NR7 + Inside Bar (NR7-ID)
strategies.entry: (high - low)[1] == lowest(high - low, 7) and high[1] < high[2] and low[1] > low[2]
assumptions: setup completes at t-1; entry at the open after bar t
strategies.notes: 2026-11-15 literal correction (gplm verify): previous interpretation used lowest(high - low, 7)[1] (window t-7..t-1); the original MIN(Range, 7) includes bar t | PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 348 mean net -0.288%; intraday trades 3893 mean net -0.137%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Minervini VCP
strategies.entry: (highest(high, 10) - lowest(low, 10)) / highest(high, 10) < $d3 and (highest(high, 20) - lowest(low, 20)) / highest(high, 20) < ((highest(high, 40) - lowest(low, 40)) / highest(high, 40))[20] and sma(volume, 10) < sma(volume, 50) and close > highest(high, 10)[1]
assumptions: pullback depths approximated by range/high over 40-bar (older), 20-bar and 10-bar windows; tightening = each window shallower than the earlier one; volume dry-up = SMA10 < SMA50; trigger = close above the 10-bar high
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 125 mean net -0.742%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: 15-Minute Opening Range Breakout (ORB-15)
strategies.entry: close > or_high(15) and not (close[1] > or_high(15)[1]) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20) and close > vwap
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades - mean net -%; intraday trades 642 mean net -0.093%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: 30-Minute Opening Range Breakout (ORB-30)
strategies.entry: close > or_high(30) and not (close[1] > or_high(30)[1]) and close > prev_day_high
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades - mean net -%; intraday trades 565 mean net -0.107%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: 5-Minute ORB on Gap-Up Stocks
strategies.entry: day_open > prev_day_high * 1.01 and close > or_high(5) and not (close[1] > or_high(5)[1])
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades - mean net -%; intraday trades 23 mean net -0.099%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: ORB Failure / Bull Trap Reversal
assumptions: the failed breakout above the ORB high happened within the last 6 bars; the 'low volume' qualifier is not modelled
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades - mean net -%; intraday trades 161 mean net -0.068%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Ascending CPR Trend Alignment
strategies.entry: min(2 * (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2, (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2) > max(2 * (prev_day_high(2) + prev_day_low(2) + prev_day_close(2)) / 3 - (prev_day_high(2) + prev_day_low(2)) / 2, (prev_day_high(2) + prev_day_low(2)) / 2) and close > max(2 * (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2, (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2) and close > vwap
assumptions: BC/TC ordered by min/max because TC can fall below BC
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades - mean net -%; intraday trades 396 mean net -0.231%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Camarilla H4 Breakout (Momentum Day)
strategies.entry: close > prev_day_close + 1.1 * (prev_day_high - prev_day_low) / 2 and not (close[1] > prev_day_close + 1.1 * (prev_day_high - prev_day_low) / 2) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades - mean net -%; intraday trades 286 mean net -0.123%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Camarilla H4 Breakout (daily bars)
strategies.entry: close > close[1] + 1.1 * (high[1] - low[1]) / 2 and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: daily close above H4 replaces the 15-minute close
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 212 mean net -0.236%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: WRB Hidden Gap Absorption
strategies.entry: (high - low)[3] == highest(high - low, 10)[3] and close[3] > open[3] and lowest(low, 3) > low[3] + 0.7 * (high[3] - low[3])
assumptions: WRB at t-3 (a bullish wide-range bar); the next 3 bars hold the top 30%
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 91 mean net -0.535%; intraday trades 1168 mean net -0.119%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Starc Bands Volatility Breakout
strategies.entry: close > sma(close, 6) + 2 * atr(15) and volume > 2 * sma(volume, 20)
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 20 mean net -0.151%; intraday trades 914 mean net -0.086%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: 3-Week Tight Closes (O'Neil)
strategies.entry: all_of(abs(close - close[1]) / close[1] < 0.015, 3)[1] and close > highest(high, 3)[1]
assumptions: three tight weekly closes before the breakout week; 'near highs' not separately tested
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 0 mean net -%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: High-Tight Flag (Power Play)
strategies.entry: roc(close, 40)[15] > 0.80 and (highest(high, 15) - lowest(low, 15)) / highest(high, 15) < 0.15 and close > highest(high, 15)[1]
assumptions: pole = 40-bar gain ending 15 bars ago; flag drawdown approximated by the 15-bar range relative to its high
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 0 mean net -%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.

strategies.name: Yang-Zhang Overnight Gap Volatility Filter
strategies.entry: hv(20) > hv(20)[5] and stdev(log(close / open), 20) > stdev(log(open / close[1]), 20) and close > sma(close, 20)
assumptions: Yang-Zhang volatility approximated by close-to-close HV; intraday vs overnight from open/close; long direction requires close > SMA20 (the catalogue gives a filter, not a direction)
strategies.notes: PARKED 2026-11-20 (dead): DEAD (loses after costs); daily trades 483 mean net -0.17%; intraday trades - mean net -%. Restore by moving back into config/strategies/library.
